public void finish (){
    sequenceOffset = new int [ nelems ];
    total = 0;
    for (int i = 0;i < nelems;i ++){
        sequenceOffset [ i ] = total;
        total += sequenceLen [ i ];
    }
    sdata = new StructureData [ nelems ];

        int [ ] mShape = m.getShape ();

        Array data = Array.factory (m.getDataType (),shape);
        m.setDataArray (data);
    }
}
